content.text:
I couldn't get the purchase vs. refinance split with these tools. loanDepot doesn't report that split as XBRL data. The full-text search found the filings that contain it but returns only links, not their contents.

**What's missing:** The 10-Q filed on 12 Nov 2024 (nine months ended 30 Sep 2024) and the 3Q24 earnings release and investor presentation from 5 Nov 2024 come up when searching for purchase/refinance origination volume. None of the tools could read the tables in those documents, so I can't give you the purchase and refinance figures.

**The closest figure I could get:** Total loans added to held-for-sale, which is a proxy for total originations. This isn't split by purchase or refinance.

| Period | Additions to loans held for sale |
|---|---|
| 9 months ended 30 Sep 2024 | $17,026,481,000 (~$17.03B) |
| Q3 2024 (Jul–Sep) | $6,545,027,000 |
| 9 months ended 30 Sep 2023 (comparison) | $17,097,155,000 |

To get the split itself, look for "loan origination volume by type" in the MD&A of the 12 Nov 2024 10-Q, or the matching table in the 3Q24 earnings release.

**Sources**
- Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 30 Sep 2024, filed 2024-11-12, accession 0001831631-24-000285 (XBRL data; flagged by search as containing the split)
- Form 8-K (3Q24 earnings release and investor presentation), filed 2024-11-05, accession 0001831631-24-000266 (flagged by search only; contents not readable)
